description: This file defines the 'EmailService' class within the OrangeHRM system, managing email configurations, sending emails, and queueing email notifications, including template selection and recipient validation.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Main service class responsible for managing email operations such as configuration, sending emails, validation, and notification queuing within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getEmailDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getEmailQueueService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailQueueService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration path for sendmail.

methods.name: setSendmailPath
methods.description: Sets the path for sendmail.

methods.name: isConfigSet
methods.description: Checks whether the email configuration is properly set.

methods.name: setConfigSet
methods.description: Sets the configuration status flag.

methods.name: getEmailConfig
methods.description: Returns the current email configuration object.

methods.name: setMessageSubject
methods.description: Sets the email message subject.

methods.name: setMessageFrom
methods.description: Sets the 'from' addresses for email messages.

methods.name: setMessageTo
methods.description: Sets the recipients ('to' addresses) for email messages.

methods.name: setMessageBody
methods.description: Sets the email message body.

methods.name: setMessageCc
methods.description: Sets the CC recipients for email messages.

methods.name: setMessageBcc
methods.description: Sets the BCC recipients for email messages.

methods.name: loadConfiguration
methods.description: Loads email configuration from database and system settings, setting internal flags accordingly.

methods.name: setEmailConfig
methods.description: Assigns an EmailConfiguration object to the service.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmailConfigurationService, instantiating if necessary.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Manually sets the EmailConfigurationService instance.

methods.name: getMailer
methods.description: Returns a Mailer instance, optionally recreating it.

methods.name: getTransport
methods.description: Builds and returns a MailTransport object based on current configuration.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Constructs and returns a MailMessage object with current message data.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends the email based on current message data and configuration, logging success or failure.

methods.name: sendTestEmail
methods.description: Sends a test email to verify email configuration settings.

methods.name: validateEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates the syntax of an email address, throwing exception if invalid.

methods.name: areRecipientAddressesValid
methods.description: Checks if a list of recipient email addresses are all valid.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Logs the result of email sending attempts.

methods.name: queueEmailNotifications
methods.description: Queues email notifications to multiple roles based on event data.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateBestMatch
methods.description: Retrieves the most appropriate email template based on locale and role matching.

methods.name: queueEmailNotification
methods.description: Queues an email notification for a specific recipient role based on template matching.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file given its relative path, ensuring readability.
